verdicts.decision_note: The client requests three missing 3D-model artifacts for inclusion in the project so the integrated-board viewer does not depend on machine-local libraries.
First concrete failure: the integrated-board 3D viewer omitted components because required model files were available only in the designer's local libraries.
The client establishes project-relative ${KIPRJMOD} model references to replace machine-specific absolute Windows paths; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
Distinct Linux portability failure: twelve absolute Windows paths and unavailable local-library references caused most components to disappear from the 3D viewer.
The client adds a KiCad-version compatibility constraint preventing 3D-model references from relying on the KiCad 8-only ${KICAD8_3RD_PARTY} variable; no prior attribute conflicts with this addition.
